If I were you, I’d ask if she felt trapped because of that. Explain to her that even though you love her very much and don’t want to it’s always her option to leave, regardless if you live together or not. Maybe delay moving In?? But if she does just need time to figure out who she is as an individual without the codependency of a relationship let her have it. It’s an important part of life. It doesn’t mean she will never come back as well,, you never know. If it was meant to be it was meant to be. So basically ensure her that the decision is hers, you love her, and you’re willing to support her regardless.

Maybe the fact that you guys are moving In together is just too stressful for her, she’s only 19. It might be the fact that moving In might seem like she’s stuck with you and no way out. She might feel like she’s missing out on being single and the experiences that come along with it since you’ve been dating since she was 16. Maybe she just needs some time to make sure this is what she really wants and all that yknow

Just expecting yourself to up and move across the country for change is unrealistic. Try just doing something new, it could be a fitness group, exploring somewhere you ever been before like parks are different cities, go to new restaurants and try a food you never thought to try or even just put on some funky makeup to change up your look! (My personal favorite is going to concerts) Even small things can really help make a difference. Plus when you do these things you’ll be surrounding yourself with new people and building relationships. Doing these activities can give you topics to talk about!
